name: Timeless II
driverConfig: 1 × 14.5mm planar magnetic (dual-sided coated diaphragm, N52 magnets)

materials.shell: Redesigned aluminum with 7-layer acoustic enclosure and dual rear venting

pros: Interchangeable nozzles allow meaningful treble adjustment
More refined overall presentation than the original for many listeners
cons: Still benefits from a capable source
Some reviewers felt the improvement over the original was incremental rather than revolutionary
insight: Timeless II addresses several common criticisms of the original by adding interchangeable nozzles, a better cable, and a revised dual-coated 14.5mm planar driver. Most reviewers find it a more flexible and slightly more refined package. The nozzles give users real control over the upper frequencies, which was one of the biggest points of debate with the first Timeless. It remains one of the strongest planar options under $250.
